meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,当你要求修复LazyCodex或Codex的bug时,Claude会在临时工作区复现问题、写回归测试、实施最小修复,然后按目标仓库交付:lazycodex仓库发验证修复issue,openai/codex发fork PR。
howto.when: 当你说出“修复bug”、“贡献bug修复”、“为bug开PR”等请求,且涉及LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex或上游Codex CLI缺陷时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复LazyCodex的这个bug,并提交修复。
say.note: Claude会按流程生成验证修复issue。
会从fork创建PR,附带测试日志。

say.text: 调试这个Codex问题,给出最小修复方案。
say.note: 会复现、测试并交付修复。

howto.what_en: With this skill, when you ask to fix a LazyCodex or Codex bug, Claude reproduces the issue in a temp workspace, writes a regression test, implements the smallest fix, and delivers it — as a verified-fix issue on lazycodex repos or a fork PR on openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or open a PR for a bug related to LazyCodex/Codex defects, including LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled skills, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and submit the fix.
say_en.note: Claude will create a verified-fix issue.

say_en.text: Open a PR for the openai/codex CLI bug.
say_en.note: It forks and creates a PR with test logs.

say_en.text: Debug this Codex issue and give the smallest fix.
